'''''Tu Ángel de la Guarda''''' (''Your guardian angel'') is [[Gloria Trevi]]'s second album, and it contained one of her [[signature song]]s and her most widely known hit, "[[Pelo Suelto]]". It also contained other hit songs such as "Tu angel de la guarda", "Ya no", "Virgen de las virgenes", and "Hoy me ire de casa". This album was very controversial different from other artists' albums such as Lucero. "Virgen de las virgenes" mocked girls who said they were virgins but had actually lost their virginity, and "¡Ya no!" went against the [[machismo]] movement of México. Following the release of the album, Gloria was working hard in promoting radio, television and print media. Trevi first traveled abroad visiting American Union countries, Puerto Rico, Argentina, Colombia, Guatemala, Venezuela, Costa Rica, and received a Gold and Platinum for high sales achieved.

This album sold around 2,800,000 copies in Mexico, which was ranked tenth of the best selling albums of all time in the country.<ref name="mexsales">{{cite news|url=http://msnlatino.telemundo.com/entretenimiento/Premios_Musica_Mexicana/photo_gallery/2011-10/10_discos_mas_vendidos_de_la_historia_de_mexico|title=10 discos más vendidos de la historia de México|language=Spanish|work=[[Telemundo]]|publisher=[[NBCUniversal]]|accessdate=November 9, 2013|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150822182604/http://www.telemundo.com/entretenimiento/2013/09/06/10-discos-mas-vendidos-de-la-historia-de-mexico|archivedate=August 22, 2015}}</ref>
